display.title: The Month of Tammuz: From the Broken Walls to the Third Beis HaMikdash
display.summary_short: A short talk for the month of Tammuz: the fast of the 17th, the road to Tisha B'Av, and our trust that Hashem will bring the rebuilt Beis HaMikdash.
display.summary_long: A one-minute talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show, cut from episode 536. Uncle Yossi explains that the month of Tammuz has a sad day, Shiva Asar B'Tammuz, a fast day on which we remember how the enemies broke through the walls of Yerushalayim. That breach led to the saddest day in Jewish history, the destruction of the Beis HaMikdash on Tisha B'Av, the ninth of Av. Yet proud soldiers of Tzivos Hashem do not lose hope: we trust that Hashem will end the golus soon, and that together with all of Klal Yisrael we will celebrate the Chanukas HaBayis, the dedication of the third Beis HaMikdash. In the full episode this leads into a march to the words 'Mizmor Shir Chanukas HaBayis'.
display.lesson: Even on sad days we trust that Hashem will end the golus and rebuild the Beis HaMikdash.
